text:
mira: quick thread — ACME asked for parity with CompetitorX: per-route cost caps + per-customer model routing and tiered latency SLAs. They want a pilot in ~6 weeks. thoughts?

alex: saw the request. main asks: gold/silver/bronze routing, pin model versions per-tenant, per-route billing caps.

sam: can we do per-route cost caps without heavy infra changes? maybe enforce at the gateway by estimating cost and routing accordingly.

joan: product idea: "Routing Preference Profiles" — a small policy object customers attach to routes. fields: preferred_model, cost_cap, latency_slo, fallback_list. lightweight and extensible.

joan: ```json
{
  "name":"gold",
  "preferred_model":"rw-large-v2",
  "cost_cap_cents_per_1k":120,
  "p95_latency_ms":300,
  "fallback":["rw-medium-v2","rw-small-quant"]
}
```

alex: MVP scope proposal: API + Console UI to create profiles, gateway enforcement (estimate -> route or apply fallback), per-profile telemetry events, canary rollout. No autoscaling or predictive routing in MVP.

ben: technical risk: estimating token cost pre-gen is approximate. we should document the estimator and include guardrails (if estimate unknown, fall back to conservative routing). also need audit logs for billing disputes.

sam: gateway check seems easiest path: compute input token estimate (simple heuristic) -> multiply by model cost estimate -> compare to profile cap. if over, choose fallback model or fail fast. we can refine later.

alex: quick snippet for API call we'll expose in SDKs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing-profiles \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"name":"gold","preferred_model":"rw-large-v2","cost_cap_cents_per_1k":120}'
```

joan: launch criteria (product):
- pilot ready for ACME (100k reqs/day)
- p95 latency for gold under 350ms in pilot region
- dashboards for per-profile cost/latency and alerting on regressions
- clear rollback (profile disable + global fallback to default routing)
- docs + SDK samples + sales enablement notes

alex: rough schedule: design 1wk, infra spike 2wks, console UI 1wk, qa/canary 1wk -> ~5wks. leaves a buffer before their 6-week target but tight.

joan: strategic note — for ACME this is parity, but we can position as differentiator by owning "cost-aware routing" and adding predictive autoscaling in v2. doesn't just copy CompetitorX.

ben: infra ask: per-tenant routing table and metrics cardinality could spike. limit pilot to 3 profiles per tenant initially.

mira: good call. add to checklist: profile limits for pilot, audit logs, SLA language for pilot.

alex: action items: @sam — pick gateway implementation approach & spike, @joan — draft policy schema and console mockups, @ben — estimate infra cost and cardinality impact, @mira — schedule ACME kickoff and coordinate pilot metrics.

sam: ack. will post spike notes by EOD tomorrow and create feature branch.

deploy-bot: branch created: feature/routing-profiles (by sam). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4321

joan: +1 on audit logs. can we include per-invocation metadata for disputes (route_id, profile_name, estimate_used)?

sam: yes — we'll emit telemetry events: routing.profile_evaluate, routing.apply_fallback, routing.estimate_details.

alex: tests: unit for estimator, integration for gateway routing + model fallback, e2e perf harness simulating gold traffic.

ben: we should also include a simple simulator tool so sales can show ACME expected cost reductions if they use fallbacks.

mira: perfect. meeting Fri 10am to align on final MVP scope and signoffs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
